summary.value: Checkbox used to select multiple options.

a11y.method: drafted from the docs page, quote-verified, human-reviewed 2026-08-11 (batch 2: agent first-pass, ratified)

value.rule: Users must be able to move focus to Checkbox with Tab
value.quote: It must be possible to move focus to the Checkbox by pressing Tab on the keyboard.

value.rule: Users must be able to check and uncheck Checkbox with Space
value.quote: It must also be possible to check and uncheck it by pressing Space .

value.rule: A Checkbox must always have an accessible name
value.quote: A Checkbox must always have an accessible name.

value.rule: In special cases, aria-label or aria-labelledby may be used instead of a visible label
value.quote: In special cases, it may make sense to omit the <label> and instead use aria-label or aria-labelledby .

value.rule: Avoid using the disabled attribute where possible, for accessibility reasons
value.quote: Avoid using if possible for accessibility purposes

value.rule: Should avoid disabling checkbox because the disabled state can be hard to perceive and some users won't understand why an option isn't clickable
value.quote: We should avoid disabling ( disabled ) checkbox, because it can be difficult to perceive. Some users will not understand what the option means or why it is not clickable.

value.rule: Better to remove irrelevant checkbox options than to disable them
value.quote: If a checkbox or group of checkbox options is not relevant, it is usually better to remove them rather than disable them.

value.rule: If possible, explain to users why options are unavailable
value.quote: If possible, give users an explanation of why options are unavailable.

value.rule: Avoid using readOnly whenever possible because read-only fields can confuse users who don't understand why they can't change the content
value.quote: We avoid using readOnly whenever possible because such fields can be confusing. Not all users will understand why they cannot change the content.

value.rule: Read-only checkbox fields remain part of the tab order and their value is still included when the form is submitted
value.quote: Although they cannot be changed, fields with readOnly are still part of the tab order, and the information is included when the form is submitted.

value.rule: A read-only checkbox stops onClick and onChange but remains focusable
value.quote: If you set readonly on checkbox we ensure that it behaves as if it has read-only access by stopping onClick and onChange . The user will still be able to focus on the element.

value.rule: Horizontal checkbox lists can be challenging for users who need to enlarge text
value.quote: For users who need to enlarge the text, horizontal lists can be challenging.

relations.method: drafted from the docs page, quote-verified, human-reviewed 2026-08-11 (batch 2: agent first-pass, ratified)

value.note: Use Radio instead of Checkbox when the user should choose only one option
value.quote: the user should choose only one option; use a radio instead

value.note: Use Select (or Suggestion) instead of Checkbox when the user must choose from more than seven options
value.quote: the user must choose from more than seven options; use a select or suggestion instead

value.note: Use Suggestion (or Select) instead of Checkbox when the user must choose from more than seven options
value.quote: the user must choose from more than seven options; use a select or suggestion instead

value.note: Use Switch instead of Checkbox when something should be turned on or off
value.quote: something should be turned on or off; use a switch instead

composition.method: drafted from the docs page, quote-verified, human-reviewed 2026-08-11 (batch 2: agent first-pass, ratified)

value.rule: A consent checkbox must always require an active action and must never be preselected, to ensure consent is voluntary
value.quote: A checkbox for consent must always require an active action, and you should never preselect the box. This ensures that the consent is given voluntarily.

value.rule: Checkbox is most often used in groups where the user can select more than one option
value.quote: Most of the time, checkbox is used in groups where the user can select more than one option.

value.rule: When checkboxes are grouped, the error message should be shown collectively for the whole group
value.quote: When checkboxes are used in groups, the error message should be shown collectively for the entire group.

value.rule: It may be appropriate to emphasise options with a larger click area (outline) around the checkbox in some cases
value.quote: In some cases, it may be appropriate to emphasise options by using a larger click area around the checkbox.

value.rule: Use fieldset for grouping multiple checkbox choices
value.quote: Use fieldset for grouping multiple choices.

value.rule: Checkbox is a composite component built from field, label, validation message, and input
value.quote: Checkbox is a composite component that uses field , label , validation message , and input to create a checkbox.

value.rule: Use useCheckboxGroup to create a parent checkbox that can select or clear all options in the group
value.quote: Use useCheckboxGroup to create a parent checkbox that can select or clear all options in the group.

value.rule: Sort answer options alphabetically unless there is a good reason to do otherwise
value.quote: Sort the answer options alphabetically unless there is a good reason to do otherwise.

value.rule: Response options should preferably be placed vertically for easier scanning and reading
value.quote: Preferably place the response options vertically. This makes it easier to scan the list and read the options.
